name: MAPP
def: Commercial prospecting rover carrying a cellular network demonstration to the Moon, stranded aboard the IM-2 lander after it tipped over.
body: Lunar Outpost built MAPP as a small four wheeled platform to carry customer payloads across the lunar surface, including a Nokia Bell Labs cellular network node, MIT's AstroAnt robot and cameras for a regolith sampling demonstration. It rode Intuitive Machines' Athena lander to a landing near the lunar south pole on 6 March 2025. The lander came to rest on its side with too little power, so MAPP was never released.
facts: Carried the first cellular network node sent to the Moon
Never deployed because the IM-2 lander toppled
specs: Four wheel drive platform with payload deck
Navigation cameras with customer payload interfaces
Semi autonomous driving under ground supervision
